products.name: The Untouchable
products.description: Our signature. Two 90g patties smashed hard on the plancha, folded with aged cheddar and finished with bone marrow butter and a jam made from onions charred over live coals. Served on a toasted milk bun with house pickles.
products.shortDescription: Double smash, bone marrow butter, burnt onion jam.

products.name: Smoke & Ember
products.description: A beef patty charred over open flame, layered with smoked gouda, pickled red chilli and our ember sauce — a slow-burned tomato and chilli reduction with a whisper of smoke. For those who like the edges a little darker.
products.shortDescription: Charcoal beef, smoked gouda, ember sauce.

products.name: Seoul Bird
products.description: Buttermilk-brined chicken thigh, double dredged and fried until shatteringly crisp, brushed with a gochujang honey glaze. Topped with sesame slaw and quick cucumber on a soft potato bun.
products.shortDescription: Crispy chicken, gochujang glaze, sesame slaw.

products.name: Truffle No. 7
products.description: A wagyu blend patty cooked medium, with black truffle aioli, 12-hour caramelised onions and comté. Rich, quiet and deliberately small-batch — only 20 served each evening.
products.shortDescription: Wagyu blend, truffle aioli, caramelised onion.

products.name: Margherita al Fuoco
products.description: The truest test of a kitchen. 72-hour fermented dough, crushed San Marzano tomatoes, fior di latte and basil, fired at 900°F for 90 seconds. No more, no less.
products.shortDescription: San Marzano, fior di latte, basil, live fire.

products.name: Diavola
products.description: Spicy salami cups that crisp at the edges, smoked mozzarella, and a finish of chilli honey. Hot, sweet, smoky — the pie that starts arguments.
products.shortDescription: Spicy salami, chilli honey, smoked mozzarella.

products.name: Truffle Funghi
products.description: A white pie built on taleggio and creme fraiche, topped with wild mushrooms roasted in thyme and finished with a generous thread of truffle oil.

products.name: The Karachi Hot
products.description: Our city on a pizza. Smoked chicken tikka, green chilli, coriander and burrata, with a dusting of chaat masala. Familiar, but never quite what you expected.

products.name: The Club Untouch
products.description: Triple-stacked and pressed to order: roast chicken, smoked beef bacon, tomato jam, gem lettuce and tarragon mayo on toasted sourdough.
products.shortDescription: Roast chicken, smoked bacon, tomato jam.

products.name: Firecracker Chicken Sando
products.description: A thigh fillet brined in buttermilk, fried hard, and dressed with hot honey, house pickles and shredded cabbage. Simple, loud and gone too quickly.

products.name: Grilled Cheese No. 4
products.description: Aged cheddar, gruyère and mozzarella melted between thick-cut sourdough with caramelised onion and a swipe of dijon. Served with tomato soup for dipping.

products.name: Cacio e Pepe
products.description: Three ingredients, no place to hide. House-rolled tonnarelli, aged pecorino romano and freshly cracked black pepper, emulsified with pasta water into a glossy sauce.

products.name: Truffle Rigatoni
products.description: Rigatoni cooked just shy of al dente, finished in a porcini cream with parmesan and a generous shaving of black truffle. Best eaten immediately, with a fork and no conversation.

products.name: Arrabbiata
products.description: A slow-cooked tomato sauce with garlic, dried chilli and basil, tossed through penne rigate. The honest, everyday pasta of the menu — done properly.

products.name: Ember Chicken
products.description: A half chicken brined for 48 hours, then grilled over charcoal until the skin blisters. Finished with lemon, za'atar and a spoon of garlic toum.

products.name: Korean Fire Wings
products.description: Eight double-fried wings tossed in a gochujang honey glaze, finished with toasted sesame and spring onion. Sticky, hot and impossible to share fairly.

products.name: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
products.description: Chicken brined in buttermilk and hot sauce for two days, dredged in a seasoned flour and fried to order. Drizzled with hot honey and served with pickles.

products.name: Tikka Skewers
products.description: Chicken thigh marinated in yoghurt, Kashmiri chilli and garam masala, skewered and cooked over charcoal. Served with mint chutney and charred lemon.

products.name: 12-Hour Short Rib
products.description: A single beef short rib, salted overnight and smoked low for twelve hours until it gives way under a spoon. Glazed with a burnt onion jus and finished with smoked sea salt.
products.shortDescription: Smoked short rib, burnt onion jus.

products.name: Ribeye, 300g
products.description: A 300g dry-aged ribeye, grilled over hardwood and rested for as long as it took to cook. Served with bone marrow butter, watercress and burnt lemon.

products.name: Smoked Platter for Two
products.description: A table-sized board of our smoked short rib, 12-hour brisket, fire wings, house pickles, slaw and ember fries. Built to be shared, though we won't judge.

products.name: Ember Fries
products.description: Triple-cooked in beef dripping, tossed with rosemary salt and served with our smoked ember mayo. The fries that started a side-menu.
products.shortDescription: Beef dripping, rosemary salt, ember mayo.

products.name: Loaded Truffle Fries
products.description: Ember fries loaded with parmesan cream, aged parmesan, black truffle oil and chives. Rich enough to be a meal, best treated as a side.

products.name: Peri Peri Fries
products.description: Skin-on fries tossed in our peri peri salt with lime zest and a side of garlic mayo. Sharp, hot and dangerously snackable.

products.name: Smoked Lemonade
products.description: Lemons charred on the grill, pressed and shaken with mint and a little cane sugar, then topped with soda. Smoke without fire.

products.name: Rose & Cardamom Cooler
products.description: A delicate cooler of rose water, green cardamom and lime over crushed ice, finished with dried rose petals. Floral, cold and just sweet enough.

products.name: Iced Espresso Tonic
products.description: A double shot of our house espresso poured over tonic and ice, with a strip of orange peel. Bitter, bright and excellent after a heavy plate.

products.name: Salted Caramel Shake
products.description: A thick vanilla bean shake blended with house salted caramel sauce and topped with whipped cream and a pinch of smoked salt.

products.name: Burnt Basque Cheesecake
products.description: Baked hot and fast until the top is properly burnt, leaving a centre that barely holds together. Served at room temperature with a spoon of crème fraîche.

products.name: Dark Chocolate Fondant
products.description: A 70% chocolate fondant baked to order, with a molten centre and a pinch of flaked sea salt. Served with vanilla bean gelato.

products.name: Pistachio Brownie
products.description: A dense dark chocolate brownie with roasted pistachios, a thread of olive oil and flaked salt. Fudgy, not cakey — as it should be.

products.name: Vanilla Bean Gelato
products.description: Two scoops of gelato made with Madagascar vanilla beans and a high-fat milk base. Simple, cold and exactly enough.

products.name: The Untouch Experience
products.description: Our full table in a box: two signature burgers, half a grilled chicken, ember fries, two sides, two desserts and two smoked lemonades. A proper introduction to the kitchen.
products.shortDescription: A two-person tasting box, fired to order.

products.name: Date Night Box
products.description: Choose any two mains, add a shared dessert and two drinks, and we'll pack it with a little extra care. Designed for a slow evening in.
products.shortDescription: Two mains, a shared dessert, two drinks.

products.name: Weekend BBQ Board
products.description: A generous four-person board of smoked short rib, brisket, wings, sausages, pickles, slaw and fries. Available Saturdays while it lasts.

categories.name: Burgers

categories.name: Pizza

categories.name: Sandwiches

categories.name: Pasta

categories.name: Chicken

categories.name: BBQ & Grill
categories.description: Low, slow and smoky. Beef and lamb from trusted farms, cooked over live fire.

categories.name: Fries & Sides
categories.description: Triple-cooked, beef-dripping fries and the sides that earn their place on the table.

categories.name: Drinks
categories.description: Cold-pressed, shaken and charred. Zero proof, zero shortcuts.

categories.name: Desserts
categories.description: Burnt, chilled, spooned. A restrained finish to a loud meal.

categories.name: Special Deals
categories.description: Curated boxes and tableside platters, designed to be shared. Limited daily.

reviews.name: Zara Ahmed
reviews.title: The burger to beat in Karachi
reviews.comment: I have eaten a lot of burgers. The Untouchable is the first one in years that made me stop talking. The burnt onion jam is the whole thing — sweet, dark, a little smoky. Packaging arrived hot.

reviews.name: Ali Raza
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.comment: Ordered for a birthday dinner. The short rib fell apart under a fork and the jus was unreal. Delivery was ten minutes earlier than promised. This is restaurant-quality food at home.

reviews.name: Fatima Noor
reviews.title: That chilli honey
reviews.comment: The crust is properly charred and the chilli honey makes it. Spicy enough to notice, not enough to ruin the rest of the meal. We have ordered it three weekends in a row.

reviews.name: Hamza Siddiqui
reviews.title: The chicken is the surprise
reviews.comment: Came for the burgers, stayed for the chicken. Charred skin, still juicy inside, and the toum is dangerously good. My only complaint is that I did not order the whole bird.

reviews.name: Mariam Qureshi
reviews.title: Burnt, in the best way
reviews.comment: The top is properly caramelised and the middle is almost custard. Not overly sweet. We ate it straight from the box, standing in the kitchen. No regrets.

reviews.name: Bilal Khan
reviews.title: A serious feed
reviews.comment: Enough food for three, honestly. The brisket and ribs were excellent; I would have liked one more sauce. Delivery packaging was careful and everything was still warm.

reviews.name: Sana Iqbal
reviews.title: Restaurant quality
reviews.comment: Rich without being heavy. The truffle is present but not shouting. Arrived hot and the pasta still had bite.

reviews.name: Omar Farooq
reviews.title: Sticky, hot, perfect
reviews.comment: Best wings I have had in the city. The glaze is properly spicy and the wings stayed crisp on delivery.

homepage.heroSubtitle: Wood-fired burgers, slow-smoked beef and plates built around live fire. Made from scratch, delivered with intent.
homepage.storyTitle: We built a kitchen around one idea: restraint.
homepage.storyBody: UNTOUCH began as a six-seat counter with a single grill and a short menu. No shortcuts, no freezer, no noise. Today the room is bigger, but the rules are the same: source properly, cook over fire, and let the ingredients speak. Every sauce is made in-house. Every bun is baked the same morning. Every plate leaves the pass only when it is right.
homepage.featuredSubtitle: Six plates that define the kitchen. Cooked over fire, finished by hand.

settings.metaDescription: UNTOUCH is a fire-led restaurant in Karachi serving wood-fired burgers, slow-smoked BBQ, pizza and desserts. Order online for delivery.
